integration: Offline relative ES modules for szuDesktop. Original campus scenes are in home-scene-world.mjs; renderer lifecycle is in home-scene-renderer.mjs. No upstream audio, player controls or world bootstrap.
rendererAdaptations: Home scenes use their own light and sky palette, a smaller sky/cloud volume, a 1.6M render pixel budget and a 30 fps animation limit.

Depth ink fades from 85 percent of each scene's fog-near distance to 42 percent into its fog span, approximately 32-64 units in the lake scene. The upstream resolution-adjusted ink sampling width is multiplied by 0.8 after every resize. Narrow-view camera retreat offsets both fog and ink ranges to preserve subject clarity. No extra postprocessing pass is added.
Host owns resize, reduced-motion still frames, page and viewport visibility pause, context loss fallback and GPU resource disposal.
